notes: Known role transitions for entities involved in the PA-08 race. The apply script sets valid_from / valid_to on matching EntityRelation rows. Only `represents` and `predecessor_of` transitions are captured here — those are the role-bound predicates in our 9-verb ontology. Predicates like 'president of' or 'governor of' would need new predicates we haven't defined yet.

transitions.note: Bresnahan succeeded Cartwright in PA-08 in 2025. By the predicate's direction ('predecessor_of'), this means Bresnahan came AFTER Cartwright in the role — semantics depend on how the seed prompt defined it. Mark for review.
